description:
Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas is a 2004 open-world action-adventure game developed by Rockstar North.
Set in 1992, the story follows Carl "CJ" Johnson, who returns to Los Santos after his mother's murder.
Framed by corrupt cops, CJ travels across a massive fictional state to rebuild his gang and save his family.

v0.3.0.description:
## New:
- San Fierro and Las Venturas are added as goals:
    - *Yay Ka-Boom-Boom* (San Fierro, 18 story missions)
    - *A Home in the Hills* (Las Venturas, 22 story missions)
- Optional missions added as checks:
    - Zero's Missions - Air Raid, Supply Lines, New Model Army
    - Wang Cars - Zeroing In, Test Drive, Customs Fast Track, Puncture Wounds
    - The Caligula's heist
- Side activities added as checks:
    - Driving, Flying, Bike and Boat Schools - 1 check per test
    - Valet Parking (10 levels), Pimping (10 levels), Quarry (7 missions)
    - Import/Export (all 30 cars)
    - SF and LV Gyms
- Collectibles added as checks:
    - 50 San Fierro Snapshots
    - 50 Las Venturas Horseshoes
    - 50 Oysters (Only randomized if *A Home in the Hills* is the goal)
- New items:
    - Kung Fu and Kickboxing styles
    - Weapon Mastery
## Fixes:
- Fixed radar on mission markers disappearing while collectible blips are on.
v0.3.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.3.0

v0.4.0.description:
## New:
- **Starting point** option was added:
You can now choose a starting point (_Badlands_, _San Fierro_, _Las Venturas_), instead of having to start every run on `In The Beginning`
You need a corresponding save file. Instructions on how to use these save files can be found [here](https://github.com/awakenbad/SanAndreasAP#using-starting-point-save-files)

## Changes:
- Excluding `Tags`, `Snapshots`, `Horseshoes` or `Oysters` will now remove their blips from the map.

## Credits:
All save files for starting points were created by **wafflejunkie**.
v0.4.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.4.0

v0.4.1.description:
## Fixes:
- Fixed mission blockers remaining permanently on a save file

Affected 0.4.0 save files will now be fixed when loaded on 0.4.1
0.4.0 seeds and multiworlds can be continued in 0.4.1 by only changing the `.asi` file.
v0.4.1.title: SanAndreasAP 0.4.1

v0.5.0.description:
## New:
- End of the Line is now another goal (*Return to Los Santos*)
- Submission sliders - every submission now has an option to change its length. Choose how many checks each activity sends instead of grinding each one to the end.

## Changes:
- `GTASAClient.exe` is gone - there is no need to download a separate `.exe` anymore, the client is now bundled with `gta_sa.apworld` and will appear in the Archipelago Launcher on install
- Collectible blips now work differently - checking a collectible and loading an older save will return the blip for it. Recollecting them does not send a new check and only removes the blip.

## Fixes:
- Fixed saving/loading storing and restoring AP progress incorrectly
- Fixed items duplicating when loaded into an older save/new game
- Spraying tags after loading an older save will correctly send checks.
- Fixed client losing checks while server is disconnected.
- Fixed mission blockers being stored in the game's save file.

## Notes:
Although **Return to Los Santos** is another region now, there is no new content besides the missions. This release focused almost solely on making the mod functional again.
v0.5.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.5.0

v0.6.0.description:
## New:
- BMX, NRG-500 and Chiliad Challenges now send checks. (Both BMX and Chiliad are gated behind Max Cycling Skill)
- Gang Territories now send checks (**Only in RTLS!**)
- Universal Tracker is now accessible inside the `GTA SA Client` (#18)
- Collectible blips now show up on the pause menu map
- Collectible sliders - every collectible now has the option to choose how many of them are randomized. A random set of that size is picked (#12)
## Changes:
- Progressive Missions logic is changed - every Progressive Mission is now randomized per branch (Progressive Sweet, Progressive Ryder etc.) instead of unlocking every mission.
- Every mission blip now has a Progressive Mission counter next to it.
- Taxi now sends a check every fare, 50 in total.
- Starting Point Saves were renamed to `Badlands Start`, `San Fierro Start` and `Las Venturas Start` in-game. (#8)
## Fixed:
- Fixed Tagging Up Turf tags not detected as sprayed (#1) 
- Fixed Deathlink firing even when turned off (#19)
- Mission blockers now work inside interiors (Four Dragons and The Caligula's Casino)
- Beat Down on B Dup is now gated with a mission blocker (#20)
- Fixed 10 Snapshot blips being misplaced
- Fixed LS Submissions being gated by 1 Progressive Mission instead of 0 (#17)
- Fixed Wang Cars and Zero Missions being blocked by mission blockers
v0.6.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.6.0

v0.6.1.description:
## Changes:
- Catalina's missions now send checks per cutscene names `First Date`, `First Base` etc. - it doesn't matter anymore which robbery to complete
## Fixed:
- Fixed `King in Exile` being permanently blocked
- Fixed `Farewell, my love...` being a part of Catalina's branch instead of Cesar's
- Fixed Progressive Cesar being gated too late
- Fixed Catalina's missions having wrong gating
## Notes:
If you were softlocked on 0.6.0 due to `King in Exile` being blocked - use `/send [slot name] Progressive C.R.A.S.H.` to continue the run.
If you were softlocked on 0.6.0 due to `Wu Zi Mu` being blocked - use `/send [slot name] Progressive Cesar` to continue the run.
If you were softlocked on 0.6.0 due to `Farewell, my love...` being blocked - use `/send [slot name] Progressive Catalina` to continue the run.
0.6.0 seeds cannot be continued on 0.6.1, but can be unsoftlocked using the commands above.
v0.6.1.title: SanAndreasAP 0.6.1

v0.7.0.description:
## New:
- Added **Street Races** as checks - to access them you need to receive a `Street Races Unlock` item that will unlock them at any point in the game. 
- All Ammu-nation weapons now send checks instead of only LS unlocks.
- Added `Max Driving Skill` item.
- Stadium Events now send checks - two of the events that require driving skill are gated behind `Max Driving Skill` and `Max Bike Skill` in logic
- Courier Missions now send checks
- Added `Max Muscle` item, it now gates all three gyms.
- Added `Bad Weather Trap` (Rain, Fog, Sandstorm) (#25)
- Schools have the option to send checks per medal (*Bronze*, *Silver*, *Gold*) (#17)
## Changes:
- `Mission Blockers` are gone - mission markers don't have physical barricades anymore, instead every marker changes its color to grey and doesn't start the mission when out of Progressive Missions.
- Ammu-nation now shows items in text rather than overlaying, with colors matching their usefulness in the multiworld. (#6)
  (Huge props to @Lordmau5 for extensively researching and creating a prototype)
- Burglary, Trucking, Valet, Pimping and Quarry can now be completely turned off.
- Import/Export now has an option for less lists (#34)
- Bike and Driving Skill cannot be earned through schools anymore.
## Fixes:
- Fixed 1 radar blip being leaked on every save/load (#43)
- Fixed `Infinite Sprint` not being applied (#38)
- Fixed Oyster 27 showing too far off on the pause menu map (#40)
- Fixed `High Stakes, Low Ryder` and `Wu Zi Mu` not being blocked by mission blockers (#33)
- Fixed radar Progressive Mission counters scaling in-correctly at high resolutions
v0.7.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.7.0

v0.8.0.description:
## New:
- Added Fast Travel marker in CJ's House, Badlands Trailer, Doherty Garage and Four Dragons Casino. (#44)
- Added a `.ini` settings file with the following options:
	- Notification duration (#39)
	- Collectible number and Mission counter size (#41)
	- Item importance colors in Ammu-nation
	- Disabling Fast Travel
- Starting Point chosen is now shown in `GTA SA Client` upon connecting. (#45)
- Added Freight Train levels as checks
- Added Ammu-nation gun challenges as checks
- Added 100% as an End Goal (#5)
- Added Jetpack pick up next to Four Dragons Casino
## Changes:
- The entire map is now open (no barricades and wanted level). Every collectible is now in logic early. (#14)
  (Thanks to @Lordmau5 for letting me use their code from ChaosModComplementaries)
- Added gating items - every early available side activity (paramedic, taxi, tags, snapshots etc.) is now gated behind an item that unlocks that submission specifically. (#50 and #47)
- Added an option to start with one unlock item.
- Tags cannot be sprayed until `Tags Unlock` item was received, excluding Tagging Up Turf tags (#56 by @Lordmau5)
- Submissions cannot be started until their respective item was received (#55 by @Lordmau5)
- All submissions now resume from their highest level after failing and restarting (#23)
  (Thanks to @Lordmau5 for creating a proof of concept)
- Save files are now stored per world inside `GTA San Andreas User Files/archipelago`. (#42)
- Starting point save files are now shipped inside `SanAndreasAP-vX.X.X.zip` and their installation is different.
- Renamed story missions and side-activity location names to be more comprehensible (#46)
- Removed On Completion mode for submissions.
## Fixed:
- CLEO no longer breaks the mod (#54)
- Fixed `Bad Weather Trap` always being sandstorm (#51)
v0.8.0.title: SanAndreasAP 0.8.0

v0.8.1.description:
## Fixed:
- Fixed `.asi` not receiving the world seed from GTA SA Client if Universal Tracker isn't installed.
v0.8.1.title: SanAndreasAP 0.8.1
